scope: Batch-local model-declared context groups and disjoint final review fact declaration namespace

observed_failures.issue: Registered numerical inputs were present, but differing free-prose scope/basis/as_of contexts made price calculations INVALID. Existing strict context compatibility remains unchanged; a shared declaration can express only equivalence chosen by the model.
Final new fact declarations reused existing extraction claim IDs F_E, F_S, F_SA, F_V; validator correctly rejected global redefinition. Internal final fact IDs were not duplicated among themselves.

changes: compact_v2 groups carry exact as_of/scope/basis/source_snapshot_id; contexts retain unit/period and reference a group declared in the same batch. Expansion copies strings exactly.

Encoder deduplicates only exact four-field tuples. Unknown/duplicate/blank group IDs fail; unused structurally valid declarations remain raw-only and do not create records. Existing context references remain supported in incremental batches.

Gateway supports compact_v2 alongside compact_v1 and legacy contracts, preserves raw wire arguments, enforces corpus/read boundaries before atomic registration, and exposes the unchanged internal snapshot/calculation semantics.

Dynamic new review fact claim IDs require REVIEW_ or the first collision-free REVIEW2_/REVIEW3_ prefix, a nonempty ASCII-style suffix, and maxLength160. The leaf is replaced as a new dictionary; existing extraction/evidence/judgment IDs and shared string/boolean leaves are not mutated.
No fact values, source locations, choices, judgments or actual model outputs are corrected or invented by the adapter. Format patch cannot edit group/context meaning or declaration claim IDs.

not_guaranteed: arbitrary wire group names after encoding again
unused group dictionary identity after expansion and encoding again

first_test_runs: Initial integrated test fixtures used previous R_J1-style declarations. Updated only mock provider to read the actual dynamic declaration prefix; production output remains untouched.
One independent test expected the earlier prefix-only pattern; independent reviewer was asked to update it after root requested a bounded nonempty suffix pattern.

A proposed final-newline rejection test was removed because JSONSchema/Python $ permits the end position before a final newline. No unsupported regex construct was added; this is a label convention, not a security boundary.
limitations: Model remains responsible for deciding whether contexts share economically valid comparison criteria. Group sharing does not certify equivalence or change strict calculator comparisons.
Unique prefix avoids collisions with registered claims but the model must still give distinct suffixes to separate new facts; validator continues enforcing global uniqueness.
Actual fresh-run success and semantic accuracy remain unverified by these free synthetic tests. Old v041/v042 artifacts and grades are preserved.
